payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request (session_99642a0b1b83, pid 568) blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_c29bf6487ace (pid 567), which ran the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and is now 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead — an uncommitted transaction holding the row lock. No other blocking sessions; the two other idle-in-transaction sessions hold no blocking relationship. Query stats show the UPDATE executed once (rows=1), so the blocker acquired and holds the row lock without committing. Indexes are minimal (PK only), table stats show no vacuum/bloat, ruling out REDUNDANT_INDEX, VACUUM, and large-data causes. Uncertainty: whether the blocker will commit on its own is unknown; remediation is rollback of the eligible blocker session per allowed operations.
